summary.name: Veloren
summary.one_liner: Veloren is an open-source multiplayer action-adventure role-playing game set in a vast procedurally generated fantasy world.
use_cases: Playing a multiplayer fantasy RPG with friends
Hosting a private game server over LAN
Exploring a procedurally generated open world
Contributing to an open-source game project
Mining ores and gems in cave networks
summary.what_it_does: Veloren is an action-adventure RPG set in a large fantasy world with mountains, deserts, and jungles. Players fight with a variety of weapons and play styles in fast-paced combat, and can craft equipment and interact with NPCs in towns. The world is described as procedurally generated and fully simulated as you play. Players can tame beasts as companions or mounts, mine ore and gems in cave networks, and face bosses in dungeons. Multiplayer servers are supported, and players can host their own over LAN. The source code is available for contribution.
notable: Procedurally generated, fully simulated interconnected world
Taming wild beasts as companions and mounts
Self-hosted multiplayer over LAN or servers
Source code available for contribution (GPL-3.0, Rust)
caveats: Platforms are not named on the page
